_comment: The site, as data. The Express server (app.js, server/) reads it to serve pages and redirects; tools/build-site.js reads it to rebuild the pages from pages_original/ (the patches are in site/patches/*.json); tools/check-links.js and the project overview read it too. To add or rename a page, change it here. If you export a page again from Claude Design, drop it into pages_original/ under the same name and run: npm run build:site
name: Terucon

home.label: Terucon website
home.description: The landing page: who Terucon is, the process, the work, and the enquiry form.

materials.label: Materials
materials.description: The materials shop: sheets, stone, terracotta and finishes, priced per unit, with a saved list and a cart.

studio.label: Design Studio
studio.description: Upload a photo of a space, pick its surfaces and see them in Terucon materials. Surface finding is done by the Python model service.

dashboard.label: My project
dashboard.description: The client dashboard: design, decisions, quote and materials in one place (a front-end prototype with a demo project).

connections._comment: Which pages each page must link to (checked by tools/check-links.js and the browser tests). The dashboard keeps some links inside its own views, so its links are looked for in every view.

overview.label: Project overview
overview.description: What every part of the project does, with live status when the server is running.
